name: Count Walzer
summary: Glockmund's largest spice buyer, a man of cultivated taste who collects fine instruments. Open-handed, well-spoken, and fixated on that old violin. He has a carriage and a travel pass — exactly the sort the Maestro half-joked could 'carry you off, indirectly.'

knows: The real price of spice (you can't fool him)
Safe travel passes to the next town
The inquisitor's standing and what he won't abide

wants.primary: To buy Eliane's violin, at any price
wants.secondary: Rare spice in bulk, saffron above all

reactions.sell_spice: Pays the best price in town (coins++), but uses it to probe the violin's origin
reactions.offer_violin: Elated, bids higher — but selling = losing the spirit-companion, a major choice
reactions.ride_his_carriage: Willing to take you out of town, for a passage, a secret, or an 'I-owe-you-one'
